character.name: Nimbu Mirchi
character.description: A traditional nimbu mirchi charm: one whole yellow-green lemon strung together with seven green chilies on a single vertical thread, used as a protective charm against evil eye/misfortune. The thread is a twisted natural cotton/jute cord - visibly fibrous and rough-textured, slightly frayed, off-white or beige in color, not a smooth thin line. Render the lemon and chilies as plain, naturalistic objects - no face, no eyes, no mouth, no eyebrows, not anthropomorphized, not a cartoon character. Just the produce and cord illustrated with clean linework and natural texture.

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
